subject: Compliance evidence & air-gapped topology: next actions
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@novamed.com>, procurement@novamed.com
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-10-21T14:03:00-07:00
Subject: Compliance evidence & air-gapped topology: next actions

Alex / procurement team — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and the actions we discussed so things don't get lost: 

What we heard from Novamed:
- Primary goal: run inference on PHI-containing payloads inside a private deployment (VPC or air-gapped).
- Requirements: SOC 2 Type II report, GDPR data residency confirmation, HIPAA BA considerations, and a vendor security questionnaire filled out by Redwood.
- Network asks: an architecture diagram showing isolation boundaries, any cross-region egress, and where KMS keys would be hosted.

Immediate next steps (owner / target date):
1) Redwood to send a focused evidence pack (SOC 2 summary + control mappings) and a draft network diagram for your review — Lauren / Ben — by EOD Wednesday (2027-10-25). [attachments: SOC2-compliance-summary.xlsx, redwood-infra-diagram-v1.pdf]
2) Novamed to share the procurement/vendor questionnaire or confirm we should use the attached PDF — Alex / procurement — by Friday (2027-10-22). [attachment: Vendor-Security-Questionnaire.pdf]
3) Schedule a short follow-up with Novamed infosec to walk diagrams + air-gap variant (30 minutes) — tentative week of 10/25.

Notes on air-gapped options:
- We can offer a fully air-gapped on-prem package (single-tenant inference runtime, no outbound telemetry, customer-managed KMS/HSM) or a VPC deployment with strict egress controls and optional private peering. Ben will outline tradeoffs in the diagram.

Questions for you now:
- Do you need SOC 2 Type II full report (redacted) or is the control mapping + attestation sufficient for procurement?
- Any constraints on where audit logs must be retained (region / retention period)?

I'll attach the draft diagram and SOC summary now. If you prefer, Ben and I can join a walkthrough with your IT security next week.

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
Enterprise Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0196

Attachments: redwood-infra-diagram-v1.pdf (diagram stub), SOC2-compliance-summary.xlsx (control mapping), Vendor-Security-Questionnaire.pdf (blank questionnaire stub)

From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@novamed.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@novamed.com, IT Security Team <infosec@novamed.com>
Date: 2027-10-21T16:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Compliance evidence & air-gapped topology: next actions

Lauren — thanks for the crisp summary. A couple of clarifications from our side: 

1) Procurement: we'll use the attached questionnaire (procurement will fill and re-send) but please go ahead and fill any vendor sections you can to speed review.
2) Infosec (cc'd): Karen Lee will lead the diagram review. Karen — primary asks are: PHI ingress points, keys & key management (on-prem KMS vs cloud KMS), and any telemetry/backchannel destinations.
3) SOC2: we need the Type II report redacted version if available; if not, the control mapping + attestation will suffice as an intermediate step for procurement.
4) Retention: by default we expect audit logs to be retained for 2 years; we'll confirm if longer retention is needed once infosec reviews.

Karen/infosec — are you available for a 30-min sync on Wednesday (10/27) or Thursday (10/28) morning PST?

We'll also check legal on HIPAA BA language — might need a DPA + BAA discussion.

Best,
Alex Turner
Director, Platform Ops | Novamed Therapeutics
alex.turner@novamed.com

Karen / Alex — looping in Neha (customer security) and Ben (solutions) so we can get technical and contractual threads moving in parallel. A couple of additions after internal sync: 

- Ben will sketch two sanitized topology variants in the diagram: (A) VPC private deployment w/ NAT-restricted egress + peering into on-prem KMS, (B) Fully air-gapped on-prem package with zero outbound connections and optional offline model/weights transfer. He'll call out where audit log sources sit and typical retention points.
- For HIPAA: our legal ops can start with a draft BAA; happy to share a template once procurement confirms they want to proceed.
- Regarding SOC2: if you need the full Type II report we can provide a redacted PDF under an NDA; alternatively the control-table we sent maps controls to artifacts and is usually acceptable for initial procurement.

Proposed immediate actions: 
- Ben: update diagram with variant A/B and highlight KMS choices — deliver by COB Tuesday (10/25).
- Lauren/Neha: prepare an evidence packet and a short write-up describing telemetry/telemetry opt-out modes.
- Novamed/Infosec: confirm preferred day/time for the 30-min walkthrough (10/27 or 10/28).

If it helps, here's a very short checklist Karen's team can use during the walkthrough: 
- PHI ingress/egress points identified
- KMS ownership & rotation policy
- Audit log retention & access controls
- Network ACLs and peering/peering-blocking rules
- Any required on-prem HSM or FIPS constraints

Thanks — we'll get the updated diagram and evidence pack to you on Tuesday.

— Lauren

Subject: Re: Compliance evidence & air-gapped topology: next actions

Lauren / team — sending the updated diagram (attached stub) and a short note on the air-gap tradeoffs. Highlights: 

- VPC variant (A): lowest operational friction. Private peering into customer VPC, egress blocked except to KMS endpoints in approved regions. Telemetry is optional and can be disabled per-customer; default audit stream can be forwarded to customer SIEM over private peering.
- Air-gapped variant (B): we provide a deployable appliance image, ship weights via encrypted media, and do maintenance windows for model updates. No outbound network calls; KMS is customer-managed HSM. Higher cost & longer lead time but meets strict regulatory isolation.

I've attached redwood-infra-diagram-v1.pdf (updated stub) and a note listing where we'd need inputs from Novamed: key rotation policy, required retention windows, and the procurement questionnaire answered where we left blanks.

Lauren / Neha — I'll also prepare the vendor questionnaire answers and send back to procurement by EOD today so Alex's team has it to review.

Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 (650) 555-0148
